explication: FoloToy AI Passport is an open ESP32-C3 wearable platform; the checked-in `main` application is a hardware-test baseline, not a finished user application. Its main workflow initializes board services, presents a test menu, dispatches button input to a selected demo, and displays results on the device. The repository also provides reusable BSP support for display, controls, audio, battery, and shared I²C, plus Wi-Fi, BLE, radio, and low-power demonstrations. The graph follows the README and sampled source; some demo internals and startup wiring are not shown in the excerpts.
